items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows three implications for a morphism of algebraic stacks: separated implies quasi-separated, DM implies quasi-DM, and representable by algebraic spaces implies DM (author lemma at source lines 681-689, label lemma-trivial-implications). The proof (source lines 691-700) unwinds each implication to a statement about the diagonal of the morphism: properness of the diagonal for the first, unramifiedness and hence local quasi-finiteness for the second, and representability of the diagonal for the third (proof lines 691-699). The translation of each hypothesis into a property of the diagonal is the content. H2.
